At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**Engineering Manager

__

**Your role and tasks

**As a Data Technician Trainee at ABB, you will join our engineering department and work with the System 800xA automation platform. The system supports industrial production and critical infrastructure, where availability, security and energy efficiency are essential.

You will take part in projects from start to finish and gain practical experience with customer dialogue, documentation and testing. Your work will combine hands-on technical tasks with structured follow-up to ensure reliable, high-quality solutions. From your first day, you will have a mentor and experienced colleagues who are ready to support your learning. We want you to develop through meaningful assignments and gradually take on more responsibility.

The apprenticeship is relevant for students specialising in either cybersecurity or infrastructure, and the start date can be aligned with your education.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Administering Windows environments, including servers, Active Directory and new installations.

• Working with virtualisation using VMware.

• Servicing and updating existing automation systems.

• Installing and configuring ABB System 800xA HMI solutions.

• Supporting system hardening, cybersecurity and IT security for critical infrastructure.

• Participating in projects, customer dialogue and testing from start to finish.

• Documenting and testing your work to help ensure high-quality customer deliveries.

**Qualifications For The Role

**

• You are enrolled in the Data Technician programme with a specialisation in cybersecurity or infrastructure.

• You are curious about virtualisation, Windows, domains, Active Directory, network topology and security.

• You are motivated to learn and develop your technical skills.

• You are comfortable taking responsibility and moving tasks forward.

• You seek input from the right colleagues when you need knowledge to complete a task.

• You can plan your work and deliver as agreed.

• You understand how to match the quality and scope of a solution to the task.

**More About Us

**At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization that emphasizes employee well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability

You will be based at our office in Ballerup, where you will join the engineering department. You will receive a structured introduction and your own mentor, and you will have the opportunity to take part in social activities with colleagues across ABB.

The position reports to Engineering Manager Kim B. Hansen.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Kim B. Hansen at +45 21 26 22 81.

The application deadline is 19.11.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

_ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable future with efficient use of resources. By connecting our knowledge in engineering and digitalization, ABB makes industry more efficient, productive, sustainable, and able to improve their performance. At ABB, we call it 'Engineered to Outrun'. The company has over 140 years of history and more than 110,000 employees worldwide. In Denmark, you will have more than 550 colleagues in offices in Ballerup, Middelfart, Esbjerg, Kalundborg and Aalborg.

_Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

**Looking for a place where you can set direction, not just make recommendations?

**We are looking for a Strategist & Client Lead to join our Strategy Team. You will lead a portfolio of some of our most strategic client relationships and be the senior partner they turn to when they shape their customer, data and marketing agenda.

As a European consultancy and a leading Adobe specialist partner, we help ambitious organizations get real business value from their Adobe CX Enterprise / Adobe Experience Platform investments. We do it by combining strategy, data and technology into clear approaches that are built around outcomes.

In this role, you help clients define where they want to go and why. Then you turn that ambition into clear roadmaps, priorities and decisions. Strategy only matters when it changes how a business performs, so your job is to make sure every recommendation leads to measurable impact. That’s why you own both the strategic direction and the commercial success of your portfolio, because we believe that lasting growth comes from staying truly relevant to our clients.

****Your Responsibilities

********Strategic direction and advisory

• Act as trusted strategic advisor to senior decision-makers, helping them set priorities and make confident choices about customer data, journeys and marketing

• Shape a long-term vision for each client and own the 12-month strategic roadmap, translating business needs into prioritized use cases and roadmap reviews

• Bring clients a point of view on their industry, customers, competitors and opportunities ahead, before they ask for it

• Facilitate workshops and executive discussions that create alignment across stakeholders, functions and markets

• Turn complex challenges into clear narratives, business cases and decisions that move the organization forward

**Client leadership and commercial ownership

**

• Own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients, with full accountability for revenue, margin and growth targets

• Spot where clients can create more value and shape it into proposals and business cases rooted in client outcomes

• Own the commercial health of your portfolio: budget, pricing, invoicing, margin, forecasting accuracy and risk, in close collaboration with your peers

**Partnership with Project Teams

**

• Working closely with Delivery Leads, you are responsible for keeping client goals, roadmap, scope and commercials aligned

• Make sure spend against budget is tracked, flag deviations early and own change order management

• Bring in the right Accrease experts across data, analytics, activation and technology for each client

• Be the strategic escalation point and stay close to client satisfaction

• Lead client kickoffs and closures, capture the value delivered and use it to shape the next step of the partnership

**Market perspective and thought leadership

**

• Bring strategic insight and senior client experience to pitches and new business conversations

• Contribute to client cases, events and thought leadership that show how we think

• Use client and market insights to help shape our offerings and go-to-market

• Be a visible voice for Accrease in the market, at events and initiatives that build our brand

**Your Profile

**

• 6+ years of experience in digital strategy, CRM, marketing technology consulting or a similar client-facing advisory role

• Proven ability to develop strategies and roadmaps that connect customer data, insights and marketing initiatives to business results

• Strong structured thinking, with the ability to cut through complexity and frame the problems that matter most

• A solid understanding of data-driven marketing, personalization and customer journey activation, and how they translate into business value

• Preferably hands-on or strategic experience with Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, ideally AJO, CJA, Target or RTCDP

• A natural commercial mindset, with experience growing client relationships by identifying where value can be created and shaping it into clear proposals

• Proven ability to own client relationships, build trust and act as an advisor who creates clarity and momentum

• Enjoys working independently with a high degree of responsibility while collaborating closely with specialists

• A proactive, curious and structured approach that balances day-to-day delivery with long-term client development

• Experience from a consultancy, agency or digital transformation environment is an advantage

• Excellent communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language: Danish, Swedish or Norwegian

**Why join us?

**Accrease offers great purpose, mastery and autonomy. You’ll be working with leading brands and cutting-edge technologies to drive real business impact. We are committed to fostering growth, learning and innovation, offering an exciting career path for those passionate about digital strategy, marketing and customer experience. You’ll enjoy the freedom of flexible working practices to complement your lifestyle and help you perform at your very best.

**Do you want to join the team?

**If you are ambitious and want to help set the direction for our clients, then do not hesitate to apply for the job by clicking the button below.

Any questions? Contact hiring manager Mette Riis Bach at mette.bach@accrease.com or +45 3139 4022

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers see what’s really happening on their production lines. Our lightweight hardware products are installed directly on the production lines and collect data from the machines without the need of heavy consultant implementations. Our hardware turn data into real-time insight on production output, downtime, and efficiency, so the people on the factory floor and in management can make better decisions. Today we have 300+ customers across Europe and US, and with a recent partnership with Verdane, we are looking to scale our efforts even further.

Coming this far has only been possible by relentlessly understanding our customer’s pains and needs and turning that into solutions that generate real-world value in the manufacturers’ day-to-day. As our customer base grows, some of the most valuable conversations we can have are with the manufacturers already using Factbird every day: helping them get more out of the platform, showing them the value they’ve achieved, and giving them good reasons to tell others about it. That’s why we’re hiring our first dedicated Customer Marketing Manager.

You’ll join our marketing team and work side by side with our Product Marketing Director, the Marketing team and Customer Success to support building programs that turn customers into long-term partners and advocates.

**The role

**As Customer Marketing Manager, you’ll own marketing for everyone who is already a Factbird customer; from their first weeks on the platform to their renewal and beyond. You’ll design and run the lifecycle, expansion, and advocacy programs that help customers adopt more of Factbird, see the value they’re getting, and grow with us.

This is also a data-informed role. You’ll use product usage data from Mixpanel and customer data in HubSpot to understand how accounts actually use Factbird and turn those insights into communication that’s relevant and well-timed. You’ll also make sure what customers tell us reaches product marketing to support campaigns and positioning.

You’ll report to Frederik Krogtoft, Product Marketing Director, and be part of the Marketing team based in Copenhagen.

**What You'll Do

**Lifecycle, adoption & education

• Build and run onboarding journeys in HubSpot, email flows and welcome packs, that help new customers get up and running quickly.

• Plan feature-adoption campaigns based on Mixpanel usage data, targeted at the accounts that will benefit most.

• Promote professional services and training to under-engaged accounts.

• Build and maintain the Factbird Academy, our customer knowledge base.

Expansion & account-based marketing

• Run campaigns that communicate our roadmap and the value of new products to existing customers.

• Build upsell and cross-sell nurture flows.

• Produce content for ABM campaigns, from micro-vertical programs to 1:1 account campaigns and source the customer data these programs need.

Customer advocacy & reviews

• Build and run our customer referral program.

• Manage the pipeline of customer quotes and logo permissions.

• Source customers for case studies (production is handled by our Content team) and recruit customer speakers for events.

• Run internal and external campaigns to earn high ratings and rankings on review sites such as G2 and Capterra.

Customer insights, voice of the customer & retention

• Turn product usage (Mixpanel) and CRM (HubSpot) data into customer insights that feed our campaigns and positioning.

• Collect customer feedback, report on NPS, and route insights to Product Marketing

• Partner with Customer Success and own the CSAT and NPS survey cadence and make sure responses get the right follow-up.

• Partner with Customer Success on customer health reporting and set up campaign triggers for accounts that show churn risk.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for a hands-on customer marketer who is equally at home with data and with words. You build programs from scratch rather than waiting for a playbook; you work easily across teams, and you always make the customer the hero of the story.

The Ideal Background

• 3–5 years of experience in customer and/or product marketing, ideally in a B2B SaaS company.

• Hands-on experience building email journeys and segmentation in HubSpot.

• A track record in customer advocacy, such as references, case studies, referral programs, or review-site campaigns (G2, Capterra).

• Experience with account-based marketing.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**

_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

__We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

Your impact begins here

As Sr. DOL Engagement Manager, you will set the strategic direction for how Novo engages Digital Opinion Leaders (DOLs) across our global portfolio today and in the future. You will work closely with global colleagues in Product & Portfolio Strategy as well as International Operations and US Operations to drive planning and successful execution of DOL Engagement priorities with strong business impact.

What you’ll bring

**Essential

**

• Master’s degree in science, Marketing, Business Administration, DOL Project Management or a related field.

• 5–8 years of experience with DOL engagement, strategic scientific communication, marketing strategy and execution.

• A proven track record of leading complex projects with functional impact, preferably with informal leadership

• Strong strategic planning skills, with the ability to turn business priorities into DOL engagement plans and see them through across campaigns and events.

• Excellent stakeholder management communication and presentation skills, including with senior leaders and external partners.

• The ability to make informed decisions in complex, fast-changing situations, and to stay focused when priorities shift.

What you’ll do

You will become part of a team shaping how we strategically work with DOL engagement in Novo.

• Set clear strategic priorities and KPIs for global DOL engagement, and drive planning and execution against them.

• Build scalable frameworks and lean processes that make DOL engagement easier to repeat across assets and markets.

• Lead projects, timelines and budgets, monitor spend against financial targets and adapt when priorities change.

• Coordinate agencies, vendors and internal teams to deliver high-quality engagements, and use performance data and feedback to keep improving.

• Build close partnerships with stakeholders across PPS, International Operations and US Operations to align objectives and expectations.

• Share DOL engagement activities and their business impact through internal channels such as newsletters, SharePoint and webinars.

• Meet compliance and quality requirements (QMS) that apply to the role.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Congresses & DOL Engagement in Product & Portfolio Strategy (PPS) team based out of Soborg, Denmark.

Your closest partners will be leaders and colleagues across PPS, International Operations and US Operations, at global, regional and affiliate level, including Global Public Affairs and Corporate Legal. Externally, you will work with agencies, vendors and thought leaders.

As this is a global role, you should expect to work with different time zones and have around 15–20 days of travel per year. Decisions in this role are often complex and need alignment with senior stakeholders, so you are expected to bring clarity, speak up early and keep work moving.

What you can expect here

We expect you to come up with new ideas, take initiative and drive your priorities, in a role where the work is varied, complex and often without precedence. You will be trusted to perform, supported to grow, and encouraged to make your voice heard. Once a decision is made, we move forward together.

You will build new skills by working across Novo’s global, regional and affiliate teams, and by learning from the experts you partner with.

What we offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape how Novo engages Digital Opinion Leaders worldwide, apply for the Sr. DOL Engagement Manager role by 18th Nov, 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

_Are you ready to use your advanced knowledge of media strategy and programmatic buying to drive commercial impact across our largest clients and grow your leadership skills at the same time?

_We are looking for an experienced specialist to help lead our programmatic offering out of Aarhus. If you want to combine deep media expertise with client strategy and a commercial outlook, while honing your leadership skills, this could be your next step!

**Driving client strategy, commercial activities and a team of specialists

**As a Director in our programmatic team, you will take ownership of media planning and strategy on some of our largest clients. You will actively drive the commercial growth of our department while shaping our programmatic offering. Joining a collaborative team of 10 specialists, you will also expand your leadership skills by taking on the day-to-day management of a couple of our specialists in Aarhus.

You can look forward to:

• Client lead: Leading client strategy and maintaining a close dialogue with both internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment between strategy, business objectives, and campaigns.

• Commercial growth: Contributing to the continuous development of s360’s programmatic offering, as well as actively driving commercial projects and pitches from a programmatic and media strategy perspective.

• Team leadership: Sharing your expertise and acting as a senior sparring partner to support and guide team members, as well as being the formal manager for a couple of the team members in Aarhus.

**Join our programmatic team

We are a team of 10 across Aarhus and Copenhagen, working closely together, continuously pushing the boundaries of our offering. We are a tight knit team and we are regularly doing social events, both as a whole team across offices and as teams in each of the two locations.

You are ready to lead client relationships, drive complex engagements, and play an active role in strengthening our team and commercial offering.

To the role you will bring:

• Cross-channel and -media: You have experience across different platforms and channels within digital advertising. Experience with traditional offline media is considered a plus.

• Client management: You have experience in a client-facing role and recognise the absolute importance of cultivating strong, trusted client relations.

• Team mindset: You are a collaborative team player with high ambitions for both your personal development and the growth of the team around you.

• Skilled colleagues: Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry and be part of an ambitious team with deep expertise across all key digital disciplines.

• Top-tier clients: Work with some of the biggest brands in the world on solving their most complex and interesting commercial problems.

• Growth journey: Join one of the fastest-growing marketing and AI consultancies in Europe with the ambition of becoming the best in the world.

• Career acceleration: Get individual career plans to influence your own professional path and contribute to shaping the company’s future.

**Does this sound like the right fit for you? Then don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Senior Director & Head of Mads Hantho at +45 30911567 or mhh@s360digital.com.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

s360 is a marketing and AI consultancy. We help brands and retailers achieve measurable results with AI, proprietary technology, and over a decade of industry experience.

We're certified partners of Anthropic, Google, Meta, and Smartly, among others. **Job Description

**SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE AUDIO ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

As our Audio Engineer, you'll explore new ways to improve the audio experience across SOUNDBOKS products by combining signal processing, system simulation, and engineering insight. Working closely with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams, you'll help shape the technologies behind our next generation of speakers.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Audio System Development

**

• Develop audio concepts and proof-of-concepts at a system level.

• Explore new approaches to improve audio performance across products.

• Collaborate with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams during concept development.

**Signal Processing & Simulation

**

• Perform advanced signal processing simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• Simulate the interaction between acoustics, amplifiers, electronics, and battery performance.

• Evaluate and develop signal processing algorithms to improve overall product audio performance.

**System Performance & Collaboration

**

• Work closely across the entire Product Development team in order to evolve and improve the audio performance across our future product portfolio.

• Apply signal processing methodologies to improve sound pressure, sound quality, and battery performance.

**Job Requirements

****In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Acoustics, or a related engineering field.

• You've designed and simulated audio systems, ideally loudspeakers, and know your way around signal processing for audio.

• You're comfortable using simulations and measurements to test ideas, challenge assumptions, and make better engineering decisions.

• It’ll be considered a plus if you have experience working with loudspeaker design, transducers, enclosure design, or audio electronics.

• You get excited by solving difficult audio problems and finding smarter ways to improve performance.

• You're naturally curious, love experimenting, and enjoy digging into the details until things sound and work better.

• You take ownership of your work and enjoy bouncing ideas around with people who know more than you in their field.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Conduct market research, monitor industry trends and competitive developments, and translate technical innovations into compelling business opportunities and commercial strategies.

• Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• Technical Background: You have a strong engineering or scientific background, preferably in photonics, integrated optics, electronics, communications, or a related field, enabling you to engage confidently with technical teams and customers.

• Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline is preferred. An MBA combined with a technical degree is considered an advantage.

• Skills: You possess strong business development, partnership management, negotiation, and market analysis skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions.

• Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

**The Perks

**We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

**How To Apply

**If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

• Data intake and migration: Mapping customer data into Avallone templates, validating outcomes, and troubleshooting edge cases.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**The Role and Department

**The Late Stage CMC Project organization is growing and we are looking for 2 Directors to lead and develop a team of Project Managers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization.

The roles have similar responsibility and you will combine people leadership with strategic oversight and hands-on responsibility for complex CMC programs, including contribution to governance of outsourced activities with contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Both postions report to the Senior Director, Head of the Late-Stage Project Management Office, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. Working closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain, you will align CMC delivery with development priorities and drive progress towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

You will help shape the late-stage project organization, develop experienced Project Managers and translate portfolio priorities into clear decisions and reliable delivery.

**Responsibilities

**Team leadership and development

• Lead and develop your team through resource planning, recruitment, performance management and succession planning, building capabilities for current and future portfolio needs

• Coach Project Managers in strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership and resolving complex CMC challenges. Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and build accountability for results

• Work closely with the Senior Director to prioritize resources and budgets across the team’s programs, resolve capacity constraints and align delivery with portfolio objectives

CMC strategy and project responsibilities

• Shape CMC strategies with technical and functional leads, aligned with overall Drug Development Plans. Lead assigned programs through integrated planning, budget analysis and management of cross-program dependencies.

• Drive cross-functional delivery of technology transfer, process validation, manufacturing readiness and submission documentation, with clear ownership and adherence to Genmab’s quality system and applicable regulatory requirements

• Ensure reliable plans, risk and decision logs, and executive reporting. Anticipate portfolio impacts, resolve high-impact issues and facilitate data-driven options and recommendations to senior governance forums

• Lead improvements to the Project Manual, governance and ways of working, including digital and AI-enabled tools that strengthen planning, risk management and delivery

**CDMO collaboration and project governance

**

• Representing Late Stage CMC Project Management in CDMO joint project and steering committees, facilitating strategic discussions and decisions within delegated authority. Ensure decisions translate into clear commitments and follow-through

• Shape outsourcing and partnership strategies with relevant functions, aligning proposals, contracts and quality agreements with program objectives, business needs and intellectual property considerations

• Hold partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and budgets. Build transparent relationships, resolve vendor conflicts and escalate strategic trade-offs and risks with clear recommendations

**Requirements

**

• Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• Extensive biopharmaceutical CMC experience, including late-stage biologics development and progression towards commercial supply. Experience with antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Proven experience shaping strategies and leading complex global CMC programs, including portfolio prioritization, strategic budget management and cross-functional risk resolution

• Established people-leadership experience, with a track record of developing Project Managers, building team capabilities and supporting talent and succession planning

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, process validation, submission strategies and the interdependencies between development, manufacturing and supply

• Experience shaping outsourcing strategies, leading CDMO governance and resolving complex partner issues with sound business judgment

• Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

**About You

**You combine strategic perspective with the judgment to know when to engage directly and when to empower others. You develop people, set clear priorities and make well-founded decisions under uncertainty, balancing quality, timelines and cost.

You build trust across functions and cultures, challenge assumptions constructively and create an inclusive environment where colleagues take ownership. You champion a ONE-Team approach, welcome feedback and turn lessons learned into improvements across the project organization.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK883.200,00---1.324.800,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our new Controller, Procurement Controlling!

Being part of our Finance division, you will help shape how procurement performance is measured, understood, and improved across Danfoss Power Solutions. Your work will provide the insights that procurement leaders use to make decisions, track savings, and connect procurement activities with business results. Working in a truly global environment, you will collaborate with stakeholders from operational teams through to senior leadership, turning large and complex datasets into clear recommendations and meaningful actions.

This role offers a unique combination of analytics, business partnering, and exposure to strategic growth initiatives, including integration and transformation projects across the organization. You can be based at one of our Danfoss Power Solutions locations in Europe, the US or Mexico.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Enable better business decisions by delivering procurement performance reporting, insights, and analysis that support procurement leadership and key stakeholders globally.

• Increase transparency of procurement results by aligning savings and key performance indicators across procurement, finance, and business teams.

• Transform complex data into actionable recommendations by developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reporting tools, and data models using multiple data sources.

• Support monthly business performance reviews by preparing reporting packages, forecasts, and management overviews within a fast-paced reporting cycle.

• Build engagement across the organization by acting as a trusted partner, delivering guidance, training, and expertise on procurement performance data and reporting processes.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Controlling, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• At least 3 years of experience in data analytics, controlling, performance management, or a similar analytical business role.

• Hands-on experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, advanced Excel, and working with large datasets from multiple sources.

• Ability to communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, from operational teams to senior leadership, and build relationships across regions and functions.

• Fluent written and spoken English and a proactive approach to solving problems, asking questions, and driving improvements.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about. We think they’re pretty great.

• You’ll gain broad exposure to procurement, finance, and business leaders across Danfoss, providing insight into how global procurement influences company performance.

• You’ll work with modern analytics tools and large-scale datasets, helping shape the future of procurement reporting and performance management.

• You’ll be part of a small, collaborative controlling team where your contributions are visible and your ideas can directly influence processes and reporting practices.

• You’ll have opportunities to contribute to high-impact business initiatives, including integration and growth projects within a rapidly evolving global organization.

• You’ll build an international network and develop experience working across cultures, regions, and functions in a global business environment.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you enjoy turning data into business insights, building relationships across a global organization, and helping leaders make better decisions, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Do you enjoy turning business requirements and market insights into sourcing opportunities that create value for the organization? Join Ambu’s Global Indirect Procurement & Capex team and play an important role in supporting procurement across an international, fast-growing organization.

As Associate Category Manager, you will support sourcing and category management activities across indirect Procurement. Working closely with experienced Global Category Managers, you will lead or contribute to sourcing projects, supplier management activities, market analyses and stakeholder engagement while developing your sourcing & category management capabilities. You will gradually take ownership of defined sourcing activities and projects while building experience across the source-to-contract process.

You will join an ambitious global procurement organization where your work will have visible business impact. The role offers broad exposure to international stakeholders, varied indirect categories and end-to-end sourcing activities, providing a unique opportunity to build experience across a global procurement environment.

The position is based at Ambu’s headquarters in Ballerup and reports to the Director of Global Indirect Procurement & Capex.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Support the translation of business requirements and market insights into sourcing strategies and recommendations.

• Contribute to or lead RFI, RFQ and RFP processes, including supplier identification, market analysis, preparation of sourcing documentation, proposal evaluation and stakeholder coordination.

• Independently manage defined sourcing activities and less complex sourcing events using established procurement processes and tools.

• Support supplier negotiations, contract preparation and contract handover activities.

• Analyze spend, suppliers, markets and cost drivers to identify savings opportunities, value creation initiatives and risk considerations.

• Prepare sourcing analyses, recommendations and business case inputs for stakeholder decision-making.

• Build productive relationships with stakeholders, suppliers and cross-functional partners, collaborating closely with Global Category Managers and function including Legal, Quality Assurance, Finance and IT.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives, digital procurement activities and the adoption of new procurement tools and processes.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related field.

• Bring 2-3 years of experience within procurement, sourcing, category management or a related procurement function.

• Have experience supporting sourcing initiatives, supplier management activities or procurement projects.

• Understand source-to-contract processes and are comfortable working with stakeholders across different functions.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and market insights into recommendations.

• Are a structured and proactive team player with strong communication and project coordination skills, including solid Excel and Microsoft Office capabilities.

• Communicate fluently in English and are motivated to learn and grow within a global procurement organization. Experience with sourcing platforms (e.g. Keelvar, Coupa, Ariba, GEP or similar) as well as an interest in digital procurement, AI or process automation is considered an advantage.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Your impact begins here

**As BMS Supporter (Adv. Utilities Professional), you will plan and deliver the facility and utility projects that keep our aseptic filling factory in Bagsværd moving forward. You will drive changes to BMS/FMS, from automation and control systems to alarm set-up, and see them through to implementation. With major equipment optimisations ahead, you will help shape the future setup of your area and support the reliable production of insulin, GLP-1 and weight-reducing products for people around the world.

**What You’ll Bring

**You have a technical mindset, enjoy working with improvements and thrive where priorities shift. To be considered, you have:

• A relevant technical background, for example a degree in mechanical engineering or similar.

• Strong Danish and English skills, as we work in an international environment.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to interact with people at all levels of the organisation.

• A proactive, ambitious approach and the flexibility to work during the two annual production stops, which usually fall in July/August and December/January.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience with validation of systems.

• Experience with BMS/FMS.

• Experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

**What You’ll Do

**You will turn technical changes into safe, well-documented improvements in a production environment that cannot stand still. In practice, you will:

• Plan and execute projects with a focus on BMS/FMS changes, such as automation, control systems and alarm set-up.

• Prepare validation documentation for your projects.

• Communicate and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external contractors, so everyone knows what is happening and when.

• Supervise the implementation phase of projects during the factory production stops, twice a year.

• Contribute to equipment optimisations and changes in the coming years, helping shape the future setup of your area.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will be part of Drug Product Manufacturing at Site Bagsværd (DPM BA), an aseptic filling factory with approximately 900 employees producing marketed insulin, GLP-1 and weight-reducing products for the benefit of patients worldwide. Within Global Manufacturing & Supply, you will join the Facility/Utility Projects team, which maintains and delivers project implementation within WFI, clean steam, compressed air and ventilation (HVAC), as well as improvements and refurbishments of the production facility.

You will work closely with experienced colleagues, skilled workers and stakeholders across the organisation, as well as external contractors. Your manager will be Ehab El-sayed.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an engaging environment where you can build your skills alongside experienced colleagues and see the result of your work on the factory floor. With equipment optimisations and changes ahead, you will have room to contribute your ideas, take ownership of your projects and grow with the area as it develops.

You will be supported to perform at your best, and trusted to speak up when things stall and to follow decisions through. The production stops call for increased flexibility, and the work rewards people who stay clear on priorities and act with urgency.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 DKK - 838,100 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn technical know-how into progress for people who rely on our products, apply for the BMS Supporter role by 11 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Ehab El-sayed, Senior Manager, at 30757584.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Specialist - Energy, Indoor Climate and Daylight
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to create healthy, energy-efficient, and sustainable buildings? Do you have experience in indoor climate design and energy optimization for complex building projects? Perhaps you have just a few years of experience or perhaps you are a senior specialist - the important thing is that you are motivated to apply your expertise and curiosity to develop solutions that enable a better tomorrow.

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

At COWI, we help our clients create attractive, comfortable, and sustainable buildings through energy optimization, indoor climate design, and daylight analysis. To grow our team, we are looking for a Specialist in Energy, Indoor Climate and Daylight to join our growing group of approximately 30 colleagues. Together, we work on exciting and complex projects across the building, industrial, pharmaceutical, and transformation sectors.

In this position, you will become part of an established, highly collaborative professional environment across COWI and Arkitema. We deliver energy calculations, indoor climate simulations, daylight analyses, and sustainability advisory services.

You will work closely with experts across multiple disciplines on both new-build projects and the transformation of existing buildings. Our interdisciplinary collaboration is one of our greatest advantages, enabling us to continuously raise the bar for sustainability across the industry

Your key activities will be:

• Contribute to the design and optimization of energy-efficient, healthy, and sustainable buildings for both new construction and renovation projects.

• Carry out energy, indoor climate, and daylight simulations and analyses using tools such as IES VE, Rhino/Grasshopper, and similar software.

• Collaborate closely with architects, engineers, sustainability specialists, and clients to develop integrated design solutions.

• Support project managers and discipline leads in delivering high-quality technical solutions.

• Participate in technical development and knowledge sharing within the team.

• Contribute to innovation and the continuous improvement of our methods, tools, and services.

• Depending on your experience, take responsibility for smaller assignments or specific technical work packages within larger projects.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. You should also be open to new perspectives and continuously seek opportunities to learn, innovate, and improve.

On top of that, you will:

• Have at least three years of experience in indoor climate simulations, building performance analysis, and/or energy optimization within construction, building operations, or industry.

• Have experience working on projects in Denmark and be familiar with Danish building regulations.

• Be comfortable managing your own tasks while making a contribution to multidisciplinary project teams.

• Have professional proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

• Take a collaborative and professional approach to working with colleagues, clients, and business partners.

• Demonstrate high integrity and a willingness to share knowledge and support the professional development of others.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to build a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and most importantly our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. That is why we say no to fossil-based projects and aspire to have most of our revenue come from activities that move our customers towards sustainability.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve, and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.
